Q: Codeigniter - How to get records from database where one fields value is more than another? A:

Try this instead.

$this->db->where('amount_raised >= funding_goal');

Right now you send the value 'funding_goal' through the query, thus making it:
WHERE amount_raised >= 'funding_goal'

You want it compare with a column and not a string:
WHERE amount_raised >= funding_goal

You can always troubleshoot your query by inserting:

echo $this->db->last_query();

After the $query = row.

Q: PL/I copybook to COBOL copybook A:

Sometimes a simple question just needs a simple answer:

2 CBL-COPYBOOK.
  3 FIRST-FIELD   Pic X(20).
  3 SECOND-FIELD  Pic s9(5) packed-decimal.
  3 THIRD-FIELD   Pic s9(9) packed-decimal.
  3 FOURTH-FIELD  Pic s9(9)V9 packed-decimal.
  3 FIFTH-FIELD   Pic X.
  3 SIXTH-FIELD   Pic s9(4) binary sync. (or comp-4 / comp-5)

  • Change the underscores to dash.

  • Char(x) is Pic X(#)

  • Fixed(5) is 9(5)v packed-decimal (or comp-3)

  • Bit(8) is, quite literally 8-bits, or a byte, on older compilers, use LE routines or home rolled routines to do your bit manipulation, on newer compilers, you have operators for that.

  • Fixed Bin(15) is a half word, or a 16-bit 2s complement int

It is worth noting that there are 35 bytes before sixth-field, depending on what comes before the level 2 CBL-COPYBOOK, that may or may line up on a half word boundary, if it doesn't, to match PL/I, you would need to add SYNChronized to SIXTH-FIELD to guarantee that it starts on a halfword boundary. Level 1 items always start on a double word boundary, so depending on what is above the level 2 CBL-COPYBOOK, this might occur naturally, but you can enforce it with the sync keyword.

Q: Installation of R-pkg arrow fails in Linux A:

In a supercomputer, we cannot install anything because we have no root privileges.

The following is my own answer, I guess it may contains unnecessary steps.

In order to install a pkg "arrow"

  1. prepare modules. (Supercomputer only) and PATH
module load gcc/13.2.0
module load cmake

(On Linux terminal)

Export one of the path of the ouput of find ~/ -name "libstdc++.so.6 which will be something like the following: (the followiing is not my case.)

export LD_PRELOAD=/home/user/anaconda3/lib/libstdc++.so.6


(On Linux terminal)

2. Make a Makevars file in Home directory, i.e., home/.R/Makevars in which I write the followings:

CXX20=g++
CXX20STD=-std=c++20
CXX=g++

3.Check the version of modules of supercomputer

  1. From the following error in the install.packages("arrow"),

    I noticed that the latest version cannnot install in supercomputer

    because cmake version of the supercomputer is a bit old.

    Error massages says that cmake's version 3.26 is required but only 3.23.1 is found in the supercomputer.

**** Not using cmake found at /usr/local/software/ubuntu-20.04/devel/cmake/3.23.1/bin/cmake
***** Version >= 3.26 required; found 3.23.1
**** cmake 3.31.2
**** arrow

(On R console)

In a supercomputer, available cmake versions is shown by module avail cmake (On Linux terminal).

4 Install a bit old version of the pakcage "arrow" from Archive as follows, which is compatible with environment of supercomputer: (This version is sufficient for my aims.)

# Set variables for C++ compiler
 Sys.setenv(CXX="g++");Sys.setenv(CXX20="g++");Sys.setenv(CXX20STD="-std=c++20");

 #install.packages("arrow")
install.packages("https://cran.r-project.org/src/contrib/Archive/arrow/arrow_14.0.2.1.tar.gz")

(On R console)

Q: You can't run lead ads until your Facebook Page accepts Facebook's Lead Generation Terms of Service A:

Your app needs access to the 'pages_manage_ads' permission if accepting the ToS with the https://www.facebook.com/ads/leadgen/tos doesn't do the trick.

pages_manage_ads permission
